question: What permission must the officiant seek from the twice-born before the fire oblation?
premises: An oblation in the Śiva-fire is intended
The officiant declares intent to perform it
The twice-born must be asked for permission
inference: One should ask the twice-born, saying 'I will perform the oblation in the Śiva-fire.'
plain_english: One should ask the twice-born, saying, 'I will perform the oblation in the fire of Śiva.'
